AFTERGLOW
a quick tour before you dive in
1
Tap REMOTE on the right edge to open the control panel \u2014 power, channels, volume, guide, everything lives there. It fades away on its own after a few seconds, or tap the picture to dismiss it instantly.
2
Hit the red power button inside the panel, then use CH \u25b2/\u25bc to surf or tap GUIDE for the full channel list, organized by category.
3
Local channels follow you. Weather, gas prices, air traffic, buoy reports \u2014 all of it automatically tracks wherever you actually are, not a fixed home location.
4
Dead stream? Live News and Live TV automatically skip to the next channel instead of leaving you stuck on a blank screen.
5
Press MENU inside the remote panel any time for deep settings, diagnostics, favorites, and more \u2014 or replay this tour from the HELP item there.
